binding_revisions: Persist no-progress only in a server-overwritten Observation.metadata.orchestration object and validate it against the current run.
Persist a bounded raw-planner-to-final-action normalization audit without arguments, query or model reason.
Use IMPLEMENTATION_READY_FOR_FLOW04_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE as the only successful 8U token; reject IMPLEMENTATION_READY_FOR_FLOW04_PLANNER_ACCEPTANCE.

review_items.resolution: Require Practice intent, server completed course, trusted course type, supported local origin, current course document/chunk identity and both document and chunk INDEXED. Entry to ANSWER is not success.
Use a private planner-local mapping; do not change trusted external provenance maps or source type sets.

review_items.resolution: The deterministic convergence gate is Practice-only; the first authorized course tool remains available while course is incomplete.
Route redundant course collection through _answer_or_missing so paper/standard/vulnerability/project remains mandatory.
Use len(new_evidence) after current-run server trust and course-scope filtering; never use historic 8Q report results or raw result count.
Use a server-overwritten nested Observation metadata object, current-run identity and strict action/tool/success/type checks. Existing AgentState serialization preserves observations.
Any previously unseen authorized INDEXED document/chunk produces new_evidence_count > 0; a mixed duplicate-plus-new result is progress.
Normalize only when the narrow Practice course predicate and all required source coverage are true, then retain full Practice preflight and Guards.
Only ActionDecision rules change; deterministic server normalization remains mandatory and AgentState summary remains unchanged.
Freeze exact/contiguous claims, classified retry, whole-candidate audit, two candidates, no upstream replay and sanitized rejection tuples.
Two product files and one test file are sufficient.
Flow 04 positive only; reuse all other locked evidence.
